instruction: Make GIMP the primary image viewer on your Ubuntu computer.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting GIMP as the default image viewer on Ubuntu. The evaluator uses a custom getter that queries xdg-mime for all common image MIME types (png, jpg, gif, etc.) and returns the most common default application. The metric checks if the result includes 'gimp.desktop'. This task is similar in difficulty and complexity to the original VLC task, requiring the same type of system configuration change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly queries system default applications using xdg-mime for all common image MIME types
Counter-based approach robustly identifies the most common default application across image types
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule' and checks for 'gimp.desktop' inclusion in result
Expected value 'gimp.desktop' is semantically correct for Ubuntu default application verification
Complete instruction coverage - evaluator fully verifies that GIMP is set as default image viewer
No postconfig needed - system settings persist after task completion
Data flow is correct: getter returns string (app name) -> metric checks string inclusion
Edge case handling: returns 'unknown' when no applications are found
